title: kb-setup and the plugin's sprint skill ask the operator for the coordination settings and write them with kbsettings.py init, which also turns on the coord hook
goal: kbsettings.py init --root WS [--set KEY=VALUE]... writes the coordination section of <WS>/settings.json (keys it is not given keep their values, defaults where absent), adds coord to backlog.json's hooks list, and changes nothing on a second run with the same values; /kb-setup in the clone and the plugin's sprint skill, at the first run in a workspace with no coordination section, ask the operator in one AskUserQuestion batch (defaults first: announce at start, claim, mid-run and edits; operator decides; strategy wait for landing, ask for working) and run kbsettings.py init with the answers

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', T])
json.dump({'item_dir': '_backlog', 'hooks': ['horizon']}, open(os.path.join(T, 'backlog.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
def init(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbsettings.py', 'init', '--root', T, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
first = init('--set', 'strategy.working=ask', '--set', 'announce.needs_you_after_min=20')
snap = open(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json'), encoding='utf-8').read() if os.path.exists(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json')) else ''
second = init('--set', 'strategy.working=ask', '--set', 'announce.needs_you_after_min=20')
again = open(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json'), encoding='utf-8').read() if snap else ''
try:
    co = json.loads(snap)['coordination']
    hooks = json.load(open(os.path.join(T, 'backlog.json'), encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']
except (ValueError, KeyError):
    co, hooks = {}, []
skill = open('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
plug = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
ok = (first.returncode == 0 and second.returncode == 0 and snap == again and co.get('strategy', {}).get('working') == 'ask'
      and co.get('announce', {}).get('needs_you_after_min') == 20 and hooks == ['horizon', 'coord']
      and 'kbsettings.py init' in skill and 'kbsettings.py init' in plug)
print('init', first.returncode, second.returncode, '| coordination', co, '| hooks', hooks)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, re
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', T])
json.dump({'item_dir': '_backlog', 'hooks': ['horizon', 'coord']}, open(os.path.join(T, 'backlog.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
json.dump({'other': {'keep': 1}, 'coordination': {'strategy': {'same_item': 'join'}}}, open(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json'), 'w', encoding='utf-8'))
def init(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbsettings.py', 'init', '--root', T, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
r = init('--set', 'strategy.working=wait')
try:
    doc = json.load(open(os.path.join(T, 'settings.json'), encoding='utf-8'))
    hooks = json.load(open(os.path.join(T, 'backlog.json'), encoding='utf-8'))['hooks']
except (ValueError, OSError):
    doc, hooks = {}, []
co = doc.get('coordination', {})
texts = {p: open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in ('.claude/skills/kb-setup/SKILL.md', 'skills/sprint/SKILL.md')}
blocks = {p: [b for b in re.split(r'\n\s*\n', t) if 'kbsettings.py init' in b and 'AskUserQuestion' in b and 'coordination' in b] for p, t in texts.items()}
ok = (r.returncode == 0 and co.get('strategy', {}).get('working') == 'wait' and co.get('strategy', {}).get('same_item') == 'join'
      and co.get('strategy', {}).get('landing') == 'wait' and co.get('announce', {}).get('when') == ['start', 'claim']
      and doc.get('other') == {'keep': 1} and hooks == ['horizon', 'coord'] and all(blocks.values()))
print('init', r.returncode, '| coordination', co, '| other kept', doc.get('other'), '| skills ask in one block', {p: len(b) for p, b in blocks.items()})
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
